features.quote: Turn budget: 30 tool calls (onset typically lands at 5–10 consecutive failures; budget ≈ 3–4× onset so you observe the spiral's full shape

early-stop a run when programmatic detectors confirm a spiral (3 identical diffs + sustained lexicon hits) plus 5 confirmation turns — typically cuts ~30–40% of tokens on positive runs without losing onset/severity data
